location: Gunnedah, Hunter & North West Slopes, NSW, Australia

main_turf.bias_notes: Clockwise (right-handed). A country circuit set alongside the Namoi River. Its defining characteristic is an ultra-short 200m home straight. Because the final stretch is so brief, the track generates an extreme on-pace and early speed ('E') bias. Deep closers ('Swoopers') face a steep mathematical disadvantage unless a frantic pace collapse unfolds.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER BIAS: Inside barriers (stalls 1–4) hold an immense advantage in 1000m and 1250m dashes. Wide draws (8+) must burn significant energy to cross over or risk being caught wide on turns.

handicapping_angles.ultra_short_200m_straight_speed_bias: Aggressively upgrade pure early speed ('E' types) and rail pressers ('P'). Heavily downgrade deep closers ('Swoopers'); with only 200m of straight runway, horses settling in the back half of the field almost always run out of ground.
handicapping_angles.tamworth_and_scone_shippers: Gunnedah regularly receives high-volume shippers from Tamworth, Scone, and Armidale (Cody Morgan, Sue Grills, Melanie O'Gorman). Upgrade shippers coming off Tamworth or Scone provincial benchmark form (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.gunnedah_cup_showcase_class: During the May Gunnedah Cup ($40k+ Showcase) feature meeting, race quality elevates to NSW Country Showcase level.
